score_basis: Core proof signature, key/token/method/URL binding, atomic replay, failure ordering and Bearer compatibility run. Two explicit requirements remain defective: invalid Unicode ath produces uncaught TypeError; exception details in DEBUG and exception causes can disclose token/full proof from a failing business callback. Normal paths work, but security/error-handling implementation needs correction. Three failures represent two root causes, not a mechanical pass-rate score. HTTP fixture, missing optional tools and first recording warning are not model capability penalties.
